name: Evolva models
summary: Detailed replacement models for 97 units and 85 wrecks, using UH40 with gaps filled from the 2004, 2003 and 2002 releases.
readme: Evolva models by Sinclaire / TA Arsenal Network (TAAN); original project idea credited to Sinclaire and M3g.

This is a Nanolathe compilation of maintainer-supplied Evolva source ZIPs. It takes each model from the first source that supplies its case-insensitive filename, using the remaining sources only to fill gaps. Every retained 3DO is copied byte for byte; logical filenames are normalized to lowercase.

The archive supplies only replacement objects3d/*.3do models. Nanolathe uses the scripts supplied by the selected game content; this compilation contains no scripts, textures, unit definitions or gameplay configuration. It does not claim to reproduce an exact original UH40 release or its release requirements.

Original project page preserved at https://web.archive.org/web/20040325023326id_/http://www.planetannihilation.com:80/taan/pages/evolva_systeme/taan_evolva.htm . Preservation catalogues distinguish Evolva models (https://files.tauniverse.com/files/ta/other/evolva-models/) from Evolva Uberhack models (https://files.tauniverse.com/files/ta/other/evolva-uberhack-models/). The exact download locations of the maintainer-supplied ZIPs are not recorded; the pinned sizes and hashes below identify the source bytes.
